_about: Dishes for tavern menus and market food stalls. Everyday dishes are listed by course. Monster dishes are templates: {monster} is filled with a creature from the monster list that has the part the dish needs, so a dish only appears if a monster with that part is on the list. Monster dishes cost more the higher the monster's CR. Poor taverns only cook low-CR monsters; wealthy ones serve dragon.
